name: 燕尾獭
evolution: 小鼠獭 → 燕尾獭 Lv.30 → 卷胡巨獭 Lv.48
description: 牙齿锋利，非常喜欢啃一些坚硬的木头。手掌心非常坚硬粗糙，常看到它们用手在脸上搓来搓去，并不是在洗脸，而是在用掌心磨牙齿。
descriptionEn: Its teeth are sharp and it loves to gnaw on hard pieces of wood. The palms of its hands are very hard and rough; they are often seen rubbing their hands back and forth over their faces — not washing their faces, but filing their teeth with their palms.
